* Knowledge of application modernization strategies for IBM i/AS400 environments.
* Exposure to API integration and distributed systems.

=====================

* **Location**: Pune, India.

title: Apps Development Group Manager - C14 - PUNE
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Applications Development Group Manager is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to establish and implement new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. The overall objective of this role is to drive applications systems analysis and programming activities.


**Responsibilities:**


* Responsible for client engagement and management, end to end management and delivery of the technology Book Of Work and technology roadmap for the Data and Reporting.
* Deliver EIM and Issue Management Data, including CAPs, Exceptions, Milestones, and the end\-to\-end issue management lifecycle and workflows.
* Influence and negotiate with senior business and technology stakeholders across lines of businesses within Controls Technology
* Provide strategic direction and coordinate with other modules leads for data and reporting integrations and enhancements.
* Lead the implementation of data strategy roadmap for the enterprise data, including data management for our enterprise data, warehouse and advanced data analytics/reporting solutions
* Design, build and maintain batch or real\-time data pipelines in data platform.
* Maintain and optimize the data infrastructure required for accurate extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources.
* Develop ETL (extract, transform, load) processes to help extract and manipulate data from multiple sources.
* Automate data workflows such as data ingestion, aggregation, and ETL processing.
* Prepare raw data in Data Warehouses into a consumable dataset for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Partner with data scientists and functional leaders in sales, marketing, and product to deploy machine learning models in production.
* Build, maintain, and deploy data products for analytics and data science teams on data platform
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, privacy, security, and compliance through quality control procedures.
* Monitor data systems performance and implement optimization strategies.
* Leverage data controls to maintain data privacy, security, compliance, and quality for allocated areas of ownership.
* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
* Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in\-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
* Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
* Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
* Provide in\-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Serve as advisor or coach to mid\-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

  

**Qualifications:**


* 15 to 20 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, Reporting, and Enterprise Data Transformation initiatives within large\-scale financial services organizations.
* Strong knowledge of the EIM and Issue Management domain, including CAPs, Exceptions, Milestones, and the end\-to\-end issue management lifecycle and workflows.
* Proven leadership in delivering enterprise\-wide data transformation and modernization programs, including new data application design, ETL and platform migrations, historical data migration automation, large\-scale consumer onboarding, and platform performance optimization.
* Strong expertise in leading large\-scale Data Engineering organizations and delivering enterprise data platforms, with deep experience in Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL processing, data ingestion, reporting, enterprise data distribution, Data Quality, Data Governance, Security, Entitlements, and Internal Audit frameworks.
* Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases and database design.
* Demonstrated expertise in defining target\-state architecture, transformation strategy, technology roadmaps, and delivery governance for complex data modernization programs.
* Proven ability to lead operational support, platform stability, service management, and large\-scale transformation initiatives simultaneously while maintaining delivery excellence.
* Extensive experience in stakeholder management, executive communications, governance, and influencing senior business and technology leaders, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with performance tuning and load window optimization.
* Excellent leadership, program management, problem\-solving, communication, and people management skills, with a proven track record of building trusted relationships across business and technology organizations.
* Ability to adjust priorities quickly and work effectively both independently and within cross\-functional global teams.

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree/University degree In Information Technology / Computer science
* Master’s degree preferred

Job Title: Senior QA Engineer – Tungsten TotalAgility (Banking \& Financial Services) Department: Quality Assurance \& Testing Employment Type: Full\-time Role Overview We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer specializing in Tungsten TotalAgility (formerly Kofax TotalAgility / KTA) to join our Financial Services Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end testing of intelligent document processing (IDP), AI capture engines, and business process management (BPM) workflows across high\-risk banking domains—including mortgage pre\-condition review, loan origination, KYC/AML validation, and accounts payable. You will work closely with solutions architects, Tungsten developers, and business analysts to design robust test strategies, validate OCR extraction accuracy against strict SLA targets, test core banking API integrations, and ensure strict compliance with financial security and data privacy standards. Key Responsibilities


Tungsten Extraction \& AI Model Benchmarking Design and run test cases to measure OCR accuracy, field\-level data extraction, and Straight\-Through Processing (STP) rates using golden sample sets of banking documents (structured application forms and unstructured bank statements, payslips, legal deeds).* Test and validate Transformation Designer rules, extraction groups, locators, and AI/ML model thresholds to prevent high defect or miss rates.


Banking Workflow \& Integration Testing Test TotalAgility business process maps, custom work queues, exception routing, and manual validation forms used by bank operations staff.* Validate secure REST/SOAP API integrations connecting Tungsten TotalAgility with core banking systems, CRM databases, or downstream BPM engines to confirm customer data lookups and validation payloads function properly.


Financial Compliance \& Security Validation Ensure automated document workflows comply with banking regulations, data privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA), and Information Security controls.* Execute role\-based access control (RBAC) testing, audit log verification, and data masking/redaction validation on sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII).


Test Automation \& Defect Management Build, execute, and maintain test matrices, test plans, and automated testing scripts (using tools like Postman for API testing and Selenium for workspace UI/validation forms). Log, track, and re\-test platform defects using Jira or Azure DevOps, conducting root\-cause analysis alongside development teams. Required Qualifications \& Experience Domain \& Platform Experience: 4\+ years of QA testing experience specifically with Tungsten TotalAgility (TTA / KTA), Tungsten Transformation Modules (KTM), or Tungsten Capture within a Bank or Financial Services environment. Intelligent Capture Knowledge: Deep understanding of document classification, table extraction, fuzzy logic, and tuning OCR confidence thresholds for high\-volume financial ingestion channels (scanners, secure email, web portals). Technical Skills: Proficiency in testing RESTful and SOAP APIs using Postman, SoapUI, or similar tools. Strong SQL skills to query underlying MS SQL Server databases for backend data validation, job state verifications, and user\-tracking tables. Experience with CI/CD tools and test management software (Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM). Methodology: Proven experience in Agile/Scrum delivery models with strong knowledge of functional, integration, regression, and performance testing strategies.* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Lead, SW Engineer, Private Capital Technology
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**

  

Lead, SW Engineer, Private Capital Technology is responsible for developing and maintaining Private Capital specific programs and processes. Primary system is Private Capital Suite (fka Investran) and all the development tools associated with it. Design, develop, troubleshoot and improve change resilient application code and execute robust effective testing. Manage task and project execution to ensure expected business requirements and related benefits are delivered within appropriate time/budget parameters. Flexibly work independently and as part of a team toward individual and team projects. From a product mindset perspective, engage in supporting applications (L2/L3\). Comply with Technology mandates as they relate to methodology, process, and compliance. Candidate will need to work afternoon shifts to support EMEA business users, including some weekend work when deploying code.

 **Experience/Skills**


Experience

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Primary experience in dotnet and SQL stored procedures.
* Experience with project feasibility, definition requirements, design, testing and project delivery
* Experience with Agile project methodologies, CICD workflows, vulnerability management and issue remediation

Required Skills

* SQL
* dotnet
* REST APIs
* Terraform and IAAS
* Experience on working on Azure Cloud
* Proven problem solving and organizational skills
* Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Work in a manner in keeping with the Northern Trust company’s core values
* Fast learner
* Self\-motivated

Preferred/ Recommended Skills:

* Experience in Private Capital and/or Financial industry
* PCS Live (fka Investran) experience
* Python
* Kafka
* Active Templates, Allocation Rules and Business Events
* ACCEL workflows
 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
